name: MuseStation
author: InterestingSoup
description: Describe a small app, approve the plan, and MuseStation compiles and installs it on your PS5.
release_notes:
MuseStation 01.006.000 — experimental hardware-test candidate.

Install with ProsperoStore
- Settings → Catalogs → Custom catalogs on → Add a catalog: https://musestation.interestingsoup.com/api/v1/
- Confirm "Signatures not checked" for that catalog (it is not part of the signed official feed), close and reopen ProsperoStore, then install MuseStation.
- Needs ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or newer and an ELF loader on port 9021, as ProsperoStore itself does.

Install by hand
- Unzip PPSA99576.zip and copy the PPSA99576 folder to /data/homebrew so eboot.bin is at /data/homebrew/PPSA99576/eboot.bin. Set the folder and everything inside it to 777 if your FTP client did not.

Files
- PPSA99576.zip: the app folder (ProsperoStore/ShadowMountPlus format). The previous .pkg build is not distributed; ProsperoStore does not install .pkg files.
- musestation-corresponding-source.tar.gz: complete corresponding source for the binaries in the ZIP.

Status
- Package layout, hashes and ProsperoStore archive/catalog acceptance are checked on the build host. Installation, launch, GPU inference, microphone and speech on PS5 hardware are not yet verified.
- The optional coding model is downloaded on the console from Hugging Face; it is not bundled.
